company.shortDescription: Medigo enables global access to quality healthcare.
company.description: Headquartered in Berlin, Medigo enables global access to quality healthcare. As a third party administrator (TPA), Medigo helps organisations navigate healthcare across the globe with an international provider network, tech-driven cost containment, and an excellent member experience. Medigo is supported by leading VCs such as Accel Partners and Atlantic Labs, and employs a driven team of 50+ people from 25 countries.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $11,044,341 to $37,492,467, a 3.39x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
